llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Instantly/Superagnt integration, but it gives an agent broad administrative control over an outreach workspace without enough scoping or safety guidance.

dimensions.detail: The required bearer key plus connected Instantly credentials can let the agent affect live business data, outbound email, lead records, workspace configuration, webhooks, and administrative access, which is broader than the narrow cold-email description suggests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is transparent: it requires SUPERAGNT_API_KEY and curl, or an optional Superagnt MCP server/OAuth setup. The external Superagnt API endpoint is disclosed and expected for this integration; no hidden local installer or bundled executable code was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact documents many mutating operations, including deletes, bulk lead changes, live email send/reply/forward, webhook creation, account creation with IMAP/SMTP passwords, API-key creation/deletion, and workspace owner changes, but does not provide clear confirmation, least-privilege, redaction, or destination-trust guidance for agent use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence mechanism was found, but the exposed remote operations can create lasting SaaS-side effects such as new API keys, webhooks, membership changes, workspace ownership transfer, and deleted or modified campaigns/leads/accounts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Campaign, lead, email, analytics, and account-management operations fit the stated Instantly outreach purpose, but the same skill also exposes API-key lifecycle, workspace members, ownership transfer, billing reads, and whitelabel domain controls, which are higher-impact administrative functions than ordinary outreach management.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use a dedicated least-privilege Superagnt/Instantly connection if possible, avoid owner/admin credentials for routine outreach, and require explicit human confirmation before sending email, deleting or bulk-changing records, creating webhooks, managing API keys, changing workspace members, setting domains, or transferring ownership. Treat IMAP/SMTP passwords and webhook headers as secrets and only create webhooks to trusted destinations.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: The artifact's headline purpose is outreach/campaign management, while the endpoint list and schemas include broad workspace and credential administration; this scope mismatch is supported by the artifact.
[SDI-2] unexpected: API-key creation/deletion, workspace member management, ownership transfer, and whitelabel domain changes are documented capabilities, but they are not clearly necessary for routine outreach workflows and lack separate admin consent guidance.
[SQP-2] expected: Raw IMAP/SMTP passwords, live email sending, destructive operations, and webhook setup are partly expected for a full Instantly integration, but the artifact does not give adequate handling, redaction, confirmation, or production-impact warnings.
[E1] expected: Calls to https://api.superagnt.com/ are the disclosed integration mechanism rather than hidden exfiltration; this finding is downgraded as expected external API use.
[T05] unexpected: The static finding is supported: credential-management and workspace-ownership operations are exposed in the same skill as routine outreach operations without documented least-privilege boundaries.
[T09] expected: Webhook creation is a normal integration feature, but the schema allows caller-provided target URLs, all-events workspace scope, and custom headers without documented allowlisting, HTTPS enforcement, event minimization, or explicit confirmation.
